question.text: The exact order of acidity of the compounds p-nitrophenol, acetic acid, acetylene and ethanol is

solution.text: Acetic acid is most acidic as its conjugte base has equivalent Resonating structure followed by para-nitrophenol. Ethanol is less acidic then para-nitrophenol as conjugate base of p-nitrophenol is resonance stablized but not ethoxide $\left(\mathrm{CH}_{3}-\mathrm{CH}_{2}-\mathrm{O}\right)$ Also electronegativity of carbon is lesser than oxygen, hence acetylene is less acidic.
